Definition: from the same as G3054; disputation about trifles ("logomachy"):--strife of words.
BiblicalUsage: logomachía means strife of words, and its few appearances are all worth reading. In 1 Timothy 6:4, "but doting about questions and strifes of words".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe strife of words is the fruit of pride — the man who knows nothing dotes about questions, and envy and railings follow.
